scope: Real browser supabase-js implicit-session handling with local PGlite SQL/RLS and simulated OAuth redirect/Auth transport. CSP bypass only for HTTP fixture; not real Google or hosted acceptance.
passed: Public navbar, feed, discussions, search and profiles require no login and expose no private email
Google initiation uses basic scopes, implicit callback, accessible keyboard control and persistent returning session
New Google user browses immediately, then completes LinkedIn/guidelines once at participation without a password
Signed-out reply returns to the exact post query and answer composer without automatically posting
Signed-out save returns to the same post without replaying the action
Signed-out vote returns to the same post without replaying the action
Cancelled OAuth is announced, cleans error fragments, preserves destination and permits email retry
Direct email login defaults to the feed; invalid external returns cannot leave the app
Password reset remains available and recovery callback stays on the password form
Logout clears identity and switching accounts never inherits a moderator UI
Email account creation remains secondary and keeps password and privacy requirements
Cross-tab account switching clears the prior user draft before the new identity can compose
Expired fixture session returns to sign-in without exposing stale profile actions
Account layout and controls work in both themes from 320px through desktop
